title: Collection Profile ACCOUNT_IDENTITY message
description: Machine-readable half of docs/spec/collection-profile.md Section 5.14 (the connector ACCOUNT_IDENTITY message). The schema checks one message. It does not check that the connector declares account_identity, that a run carries at most one message, or that a declaring connector emits one; the runtime checks those (Section 5.14).

account_id.description: The stable upstream account id, as a string with no whitespace.
